sources.title: git-write-tree
usage: `references/verdicts-and-deliveries.md` → Matching a verdict to the worktree

claims.statement: `git write-tree` reads the index named by `GIT_INDEX_FILE`, so a private index inside a subshell yields the tree of the worktree without touching the real index → verdicts and deliveries, Gotchas

sources.title: Xonovex change-workflow conventions
sources.provenance: Repository-original rules for closing out a work package, built on the contract of **recording-handoff**: the met, gated and open states, re-derived evidence, the integration seams, the kinds of blocker, the decision register, open points and residue, follow-up seeds, the delivery that is prepared and not applied, and the close-out file that a rerun replaces

claims.statement: The close-out runs the entry step of **recording-handoff** first and writes the log entry of its run; its file is replaced by the next run because git keeps the history; the knowledge skills it loads come from the skills map of the `validating-work-package` phase; a delivery that no step applied is reported for the user to commit and publish through **using-git** and **using-github** or **using-gitlab**.
